transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. How can I help you today?

I'm... I'm just having some trouble at work lately. I can't seem to keep my head clear. I'll be sitting there, and I just lose track of what my clients are saying. Or I'll be reading a chart note, and I have to read the same sentence over and over. And then... I just kind of freeze up on simple decisions that never used to be a problem. So, I figured I should come in.
Have you been feeling down, depressed, or have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy, like hobbies or time with family and friends?

I guess so. Um... I haven't really been doing much. My guitar's just been sitting in the corner for a while. I keep bailing on soccer... and my shifts at the shelter. I try to do stuff, like cooking or going hiking, but... I don't know, it just feels like going through the motions. There's no point to it right now.
Have you been feeling down or losing interest in activities for most of the day, nearly every day, for the past two weeks or more?

Yeah... it's been about a month, I think. We lost some staff at the clinic, so... my schedule got shifted to late-evening coverage. Just dealing with a lot more crisis paperwork now. I guess it started around then.
Do you find yourself feeling anxious or worrying a lot about things, even when you know they might not be a big deal?
Not really, no. I mean... I'm not really worrying about things like that. It's just... everything feels heavy, I guess. But not anxious.
Have you been feeling more tired or lacking energy, even if you've gotten enough rest?

Yeah. I guess... I'm pretty tired. Um... even just doing small stuff, like taking a shower... or driving to the clinic. Getting through that paperwork I mentioned. It just... I don't know. Feels like I'm dragging around a backpack full of bricks.
Have you been feeling like you're not good enough or blamed yourself for things more than usual?

Yeah... I guess so. Um. Just... at work, mostly. If I miss a detail in a note, or... forget to return a call right away... I don't know. I just get in my head about it. I keep telling myself I'm useless... that I'm letting the clients down. And everyone else at the clinic, too.
Have you ever felt like life isn't worth living or had thoughts about harming yourself?

Um... I don't... I don't have a plan to do anything. To hurt myself, I mean. But... I guess I keep having these thoughts. Just... like it would be easier if I didn't wake up. And... um. That scares me a bit. Just because I... I know what that can mean.
Have you noticed that things that used to bring you joy or pleasure don't seem to anymore?

Yeah, I guess. Um... my guitar's just been sitting in the corner. I keep... making excuses to get out of soccer, or going to the shelter. And... I don't know, even if I try to cook, or go hiking... it just feels like I'm going through the motions. Like there's no point.
Have you noticed a loss of pleasure in most activities that you used to enjoy, or do they just feel like a chore now?
Um... yeah, I think I just said that. Everything just feels... like a chore, I guess. I don't really want to do any of it.
Have you experienced any physical restlessness, an urge to move constantly, or a feeling of being on edge that you didn’t mention before?
Um... no. Not really. I haven't noticed anything like that. I don't really... have much of an urge to move around.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately, like eating much less or much more than usual?

Um... yeah, I guess I'm eating less. I don't really feel hungry most days... not until someone reminds me to eat, anyway. And... my pants have gotten kind of loose. I just sort of skip meals without really meaning to.
Have you noticed that your thoughts feel slowed down or that you're moving more slowly than usual, like everything is in slow motion?
Um... no, not really. I mean, I'm just... sitting around more, I guess. But I don't feel like I'm moving in slow motion or anything. My thoughts are just... normal.
Have you noticed that you're moving much more slowly than usual or that you can't sit still, like there's a physical slowing or restlessness that others might notice?
Um... I think you just asked me about that. But... no. I haven't noticed anything like that. And nobody else has said anything to me about how I'm moving, either.
Have you completely lost interest in doing things you used to care about, like work, hobbies, or spending time with people?

Yeah, I guess so. I just... don't really care anymore. My guitar is just sitting in the corner collecting dust. I keep bailing on my soccer games and... skipping my shifts at the animal shelter. Even when I try to do stuff I used to like, like cooking or going for a hike, it's just... I don't know. It feels like I'm just going through the motions. There's no point to it.
Have you experienced these symptoms every day, nearly all day, for most days over the past month?

Yeah... pretty much. It's been going on for about a month, I guess. Right around when the clinic lost some staff. They shifted my schedule to late-evening coverage and... I've just had heavier crisis paperwork to deal with. So... yeah. Every day.
Do you think your symptoms would improve if the stress at work were reduced, or do they seem to be affecting you regardless of the situation?
I don't know. I mean... maybe? It's hard to tell. I just... I feel this way all the time right now. Even when I'm not there. So... I'm not really sure if it would change anything.
